title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-107-26二模

items.zh: 每天做点洗碗之类的家务活对培养耐心很管用。
items.en: Everyday chores like dishwashing have an obvious effect on cultivating patience.

items.zh: 当初我们选这款氢能源汽车时,看中的就是它的续航里程。
items.en: Initially, what mattered to us when choosing the hydrogen vehicle was its driving range.

items.zh: 天气转凉时,他的胃会不舒服,奶奶经常提醒他把牛奶热一下再喝。
items.en: When the weather turns cool, he tends to get an upset stomach, so his grandma always reminds him not to drink milk unless he warms it up.

items.zh: 这部关于宋朝历史的小说一出版便备受推崇,连外国读者都争相购买,销售量远超同类作品。
items.en: Once published, the novel about the Song Dynasty won wide acclaim, whose sales far outperformed those of similar works, with foreign readers racing to buy it.
